chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: In the series of customizing AI models in business, we talk about the Retrieval Augmented Generations, RAGs.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: What is Retrieval Augmented Generation, RAG, in AI?

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Well, Retrieval Augmented Generation, or RAG, combines the strengths of retrieval-based methods and generative models to produce more accurate and contextually relevant responses.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: The RAG architecture typically involves two main components, a retriever and a generator.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Let's delve into the components of RAG.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: The first component, the retriever, searches a large corpus of documents or data to find the most relevant pieces of information based on a given query.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: The second component, the generator, uses the information retrieved by the retriever to generate a coherent and contextually appropriate response.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Now let's walk through the step-by-step process of RAG.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Step 1. Query Input. A user submits a query. For example, what are the company's health benefits?

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Step 2. Retrieval. The retriever searches the knowledge base to find relevant documents or passages.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: This knowledge base can include a wide range of data sources such as internal documents, FAQs, policy manuals, and other relevant information.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Step 3. Relevant Documents. The retriever returns the top-end relevant documents or passages.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: For example, it might find the company health benefits document and relevant sections from the employee handbook.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Step 4. Generation. The generator takes the query and the retrieved documents as input and generates a detailed and contextually relevant response.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: It synthesizes information from the retrieved documents to create a comprehensive answer.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Step 5. Response Output. The generated response is presented to the user.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: For example, our company offers comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Employees are eligible for these benefits from their first day of employment.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: For more details, please refer to the health benefits section in the employee handbook or visit the HR portal.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: How does RAG enhance performance?

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Improved Accuracy.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: By retrieving relevant documents first, the system ensures that the generative model has access to the most pertinent information, leading to more accurate responses.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Contextual Relevance. The generative model can create responses that are not only accurate but also contextually appropriate, incorporating specific details from the retrieved documents.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Scalability RAG systems can handle large volumes of queries and retrieve information from extensive datasets, making them suitable for enterprise applications.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Consistency responses generated using RAG are consistent and based on up-to-date information from the knowledge base.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Next come the practical implementation and real-world examples.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Before we move to practical implementation part, please watch our other video on this series for complete knowledge on customizing AI models in business.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Also, please subscribe to our channel and watch till the end, and comment us for providing more content like this.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: In practical implementation, we start with data collection, where we gather and organize documents, FAQs, and other relevant data into a searchable repository.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Next is model training, where we train the retriever to efficiently search the repository and the generative model to synthesize responses from the retrieved documents.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Then, there's system integration, where we integrate the RAG system with the enterprise's existing tools and platforms, such as HR portals or customer support systems.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Finally, we focus on continuous improvement by regularly updating the knowledge base and refining the retriever and generator models based on feedback and new information.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Let's look at a real-world example of HR support.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: An employee asks, how can I apply for parental leave?

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: The system then retrieves relevant sections from the employee handbook, company policy documents, and previous related inquiries.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: The system generates a response.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: To apply for parental leave, submit a leave application form through the HR portal, attach necessary documents, and notify your supervisor.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: For detailed steps, refer to the parental leave policy in the employee handbook.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: The response is provided to the employee through the HR portal.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: By integrating retrieval and generation, RAG systems provide powerful solutions for enterprises, enhancing the accuracy and relevance of automated responses across various applications.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: How is it different from previous enterprise applications?

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Let's consider the HR support use case.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Previously, employees would manually search an HR portal for documents related to parental leave, often having to read through several documents to piece together the required information.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: Chatbots might provide generic answers based on outdated or incomplete information.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: With the RAG approach, the system efficiently retrieves the most relevant sections from updated HR documents and policies.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: It generates a detailed and specific answer, such as,

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: To apply for parental leave, please follow these steps.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: 1. Submit a leave application form through the HR portal.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: 2. Attach necessary documents, such as medical certificates or adoption papers.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: 3. Notify your supervisor.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: For detailed instructions, refer to the parental leave policy in the employee handbook.

chunks.title: RAG Explained in 5 minutes
chunks.text: In summary, RAG systems offer a more sophisticated, accurate, and user-friendly approach compared to previous enterprise applications, leveraging the combined power of retrieval and generation to provide high-quality, contextually relevant responses.
